description: Start a review or coverage iteration loop on a feature. Returns loop state.

maxIterations.description: Override max iterations (optional, defaults from settings). A review loop above its tier cap is refused ROUND_CAP_EXCEEDED.

tier.description: Review loops only (default standard). Sets the round cap: bounded 1, standard 2, security 2 (a 3rd round only when round 2 has a HIGH of a new class). review-loop.md:6

name: start_iteration_loop
